human_summary: Foundation gate. Extraction outputs must not carry a bare declarative causal/diagnostic/mechanistic claim in the tool's own voice; interpretation must be tagged, attributed, or inside a verbatim [src:] quote. Register-shape only; condition-agnostic. src_fidelity (Layer 3a) hard-denies a fabricated [src: F,..,"quote"] whose quote does not resolve in a text F. provenance_reconcile (Layer 3b) is ADVISORY: for a DERIVED/CURATED extract it flags concrete factual tokens corroborated by no primary source (warn, never blocks).
